Simple but Flexible

PagePlay is a simple to master tool which anybody can enjoy using to manage a website. The point and click nature of making changes means you will be in total control from the first time you log in.

Unlimited Content

Pages, images, videos, you name it you can add as much and as often as you like. We don't limit usage or apply additional charges for adding all the content you need.

Friendly Phone Support

Included as part of your subscription, you can pick up the phone and ask a human for help whenever you need. No automated system or queuing required.

Mobile Responsiveness

As part of your setup you can choose to have a responsive design created. Tested on all device widths, you can be sure your site will look great to everybody from those on mobiles through to large desktops.

Free Domain Name

We'll renew and manage your domain name as part of your subscription. No risk of forgetting to renew or getting the settings wrong.

Rank Well in Search Engines

We'll ensure the site has all the technical boxes ticked so that only regular content management is needed to rank well in search results.

Update Anything

Although most changes and additions will be made in the main area of your website's pages, with PagePlay you can update almost anything on the page using the same simple interface.

Photo Copyright Protection

If you have images you want to share with the world, but you still need to protect them from reuse, PagePlay can automatically watermark some or all of your images.

Email Included

PagePlay websites come with basic email accounts included for free. Connect using standard IMAP methods, or use our browser based email system.

Email Forwarders and Autoresponders

As well as email accounts you can manage email forwarders and autoresponders right from your PagePlay site using a simple interface.

Photo Editing

Easy to use tools for uploading, resizing and cropping your photos are part of all PagePlay subscriptions.

Page Management

Every editor can access the simple way to add, move and even nest your site's pages.
